* '''PC-E2''' ([[Run'heb Voend (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages; publisher edition line “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”).</ref>, page 1, October 2026 edition: “Once per game, may ▼ a sandcrawler here. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]] (PC-E1).
